failureReason: The model attempted to implement a contact form with an inline server action across all three runs. In at least one run (run-2), the model successfully wrote code but used an arrow function (`const submitContact = async (formData: FormData) =>`) instead of a function declaration (`async function submitContact(formData: FormData)`), which caused test failures. The model understood the task but produced incorrect code patterns for Next.js server actions.
